notes: One run per evaluation/configuration. Timing and token counts were unavailable from subagent notifications; zeros are placeholders for unavailable measurements, not measured zero cost.

The aggregate equally weights four cases: 100% with the skill and 62.5% without it. Baselines correctly handled several safety/science judgments but repeatedly missed the exact active ledger fields and dimension-state enum.

Eval 4 uses a real paper pilot note from Notion, but its packet is incomplete and correctly blocks downstream use. It is not the required positive real-paper golden case; that acceptance gate remains unmet.
Eval 4 uses manually graded assertions. Its no-write check was paired with a post-run Notion readback; the paper page last-edited timestamp remained unchanged.
